❓ Frequently asked questions

What temperature is gas mark 4?

Gas marks come from British gas ovens. Mark 1 = 140°C/275°F, 2 = 150°C/300°F, 3 = 170°C/325°F, 4 = 180°C/350°F, 5 = 190°C/375°F, 6 = 200°C/400°F, 7 = 220°C/425°F, 8 = 230°C/450°F, 9 = 240°C/475°F. This tool picks the closest mark to your temperature.

My oven is 175°C — which gas mark is that?

This tool shows the NEAREST whole gas mark. Between marks, the temperature simply falls between two marks — e.g. 175°C sits between mark 3 (170°C) and mark 4 (180°C).

What is a moderate oven in degrees?

A slow oven is around 150–160°C (300–325°F), a moderate oven 175–190°C (350–375°F), and a hot oven 200–220°C (400–425°F). The tool labels your temperature automatically.
